title: Layer file
description: One map layer: pipeline/layers/<layer>.yaml. The layer name is the file name. `source`, `fields` and `processing` say how it is built; `display` how it is drawn. Design note 04.

title.description: Layer name shown in the layer panel.

visible.description: Switched on when the map opens. Default false.

order.description: Draw order: higher on top and first in the layer panel; ties by layer name. Default 0.

allOf.description: A raster layer: no attributes, no pop-up, no vector settings.
Low-zoom generalisation settings belong to the coverage profile.

name.description: An output attribute name: lower case letters, digits and _.

sourceField.description: An attribute name in the source data, as it is there.

fieldList.description: Attributes to keep, in order: a name keeps the attribute as it is; a one-key map `{source_name: output_name}` renames it.

sourceSettings.description: The source settings, none required (a map config override sets only some).

path.description: The dataset: a path under RAW_DIR, an absolute path, or a GDAL /vsi path. Anything GDAL opens; a .zip is read in place.

layer.description: Vector only: the layer inside the dataset (a geodatabase or GeoPackage). Default the first.

id.description: Vector only, required: the source attribute holding a unique integer, written as the tile feature id (not repeated as an attribute).

srs.description: The source CRS, for example EPSG:3347, for data without a usable one.

encoding.description: Vector only: the attribute encoding, for example ISO-8859-1, for a shapefile without a .cpg.

nodata.description: Raster only: the source nodata value, for a raster that declares none or the wrong one.

joins.description: Vector only: attributes added from non-spatial tables (a CSV, or a table in a dataset), matched by key.

join.description: One join: rows of `path` (and `layer`) whose `on` attribute equals the source's `on` attribute.

path.description: The table: a path under RAW_DIR or an absolute path.

layer.description: The table inside the dataset. Default the first.

on.description: The key attribute, by the same name in the source and the table.

fields.description: Table attributes to add, as in `fields.keep`. Default all but the key.
Vector only: the attributes in the tiles. Everything else is dropped.

keep.description: Source attributes to keep: a name as it is, or `{source_name: output_name}` to rename.

calculated.description: New attributes: name to a SQLite expression on the kept attributes (output names), run by ogr2ogr -dialect SQLite. A comparison gives 1 or 0, as for an action recommendation.

processingSettings.description: The processing settings, none required (a map config override sets only some).

profile.description: The preset. `default`: lines and polygons, simplified below the max zoom only. `coverage`: polygons that tile the land without overlaps; shared borders kept identical, the smallest dropped first when a tile is full, and the zooms below the max generalised (small parts dropped, borders simplified). `points`: every point at every zoom. `raster`: a binary raster, a Web Mercator COG, display only. Default `default`.

maxzoom.description: Highest zoom built; the map overzooms past it. For a raster, also its resolution (z12 is about 20 to 27 m across Canada), at most 14.

min_part_px.description: Coverage only: below the max zoom, drop polygon parts smaller than this many screen pixels (each feature keeps its largest part). Default 4.

simplify_px.description: Coverage only: below the max zoom, simplify borders by this many screen pixels; 0 for none. Default 1.

min_visible_px.description: Vector only: the drop guard fails the build if a polygon whose largest part covers this many screen pixels is missing from a zoom. Default 1.

grey_levels.description: Raster only: how many evenly spaced shares of cover (0 to 255) the COG keeps, 2 to 256. Fewer compress better. Default 256.

tippecanoe.description: Advanced, vector only: extra tippecanoe arguments, added after the preset's, for layers the presets do not fit (dense points, detailed lines, large polygon sets), such as `--drop-densest-as-needed`. Each is one argument starting with `--`, its value after `=`. A change makes the layer stale.

processing.description: How the tiles or the COG are made.

display.description: How the layer is drawn and what a click shows.

layers.description: MapLibre style layers, in draw order (last on top), as they will appear in style.json. The pipeline adds `source`, `source-layer` and the `<layer>-` id prefix.

legend.description: An explicit legend, for when the one the app builds from the colour expression is not enough. Not with `themes`, which have their own.

styleId.description: A short id, unique within the layer, such as `fill`.

styleLayer.description: A MapLibre style layer without `source` and `source-layer`. Paint, layout and filter are checked against the MapLibre style spec by the web app's tests.

type.description: The MapLibre layer type. A binary raster is a `color-relief` layer on the COG.

metadata.description: Free-form data, kept as it is.

themes.description: "Colour by" choices in the layer panel. The first is what `layers` draw (it has no `paint`); each other one replaces paint properties of some style layers.

label.description: The name in the "Colour by" list.

paint.description: Style layer id to the paint properties this theme sets on it.

legend.description: This theme's legend, when the derived one is not enough.

color.description: A CSS colour, as MapLibre accepts it, for example #2c7fb8.

legend.description: A legend, used as it is. Parts left out are taken from the derived legend.

kind.description: `ramp` for classes of a number, `gradient` for a continuous ramp, `categories`, or `single` for one colour.

shape.description: Swatch shape: `square` for fills, `circle` for points, `line` for lines.

position.description: In a `gradient` legend, where the colour sits on the bar, 0 to 1. Items without one show as separate swatches.

valueSource.description: Where a value comes from: a tile attribute, or the feature id.

formatPreset.description: A named number format, in the map's locale with thousands separators: `number` (decimals as the value has them, up to 3), `integer` (0 decimals), `percent` (a value 0 to 100: 1 decimal and %). Units go in `suffix`.

numberFormat.description: A number format: a `preset` (default `number`), changed by `decimals`, `grouping` and `suffix`.

suffix.description: Unit after the number, after a space (`%` directly), such as `ha` or `km`.

format.description: How a number is shown: a preset name or a number format. Without one, values are shown as they are.

template.description: Text with placeholders: `{attribute}` as it is, `{attribute:preset}` in a format preset, `{$id}` the feature id.

cellAttribute.description: The attribute for one value, or null for an empty cell.

attributesBlock.description: Labelled values. Items without a value are hidden, and the block with none left.

tableBlock.description: A table of rows by columns; each row gives one attribute per column. Rows with no values are hidden, and the table with none left.

rowHeader.description: Heading of the row label column.

chartBlock.description: A Chart.js chart over `categories`. `bar` and `line` take one or more series (several make a grouped bar chart or several lines, with a legend); `pie` and `doughnut` exactly one. Each series gives one attribute per category. Hidden with no values.

valueLabel.description: What the values are, for the accessible summary.

colors.description: Slice colours of a pie or doughnut, one per category.

textBlock.description: A paragraph; hidden when a placeholder has no value.

listBlock.description: A bulleted list, such as recommended actions. An item shows when its `when` attribute is true (not 0, empty, false or no) and its placeholders have values; with none, `empty` shows.

when.description: Show only when this attribute is true.

block.description: One block of a pop-up section.

section.description: An optional heading and description, then blocks. Hidden when every block is.

heading.description: Section heading; required in a dialog.

tab.description: A shorter tab label in a dialog; default the heading. Tab labels are unique.

popupSize.description: `small` (default): one section in a pop-up at the click; `dialog`: sections in a dialog over the map.

popupLayout.description: How a dialog shows its sections: `tabs` (default), one at a time; `scroll`, all in one scrolling dialog.

popup.description: What a click on a feature shows, filled from its attributes: a small pop-up at the click or a dialog. Without one the layer is not clickable.

title.description: The heading; the layer title when a placeholder has no value.

subtitle.description: A line under the heading; hidden when a placeholder has no value.

then.description: A dialog: every section has a heading.

else.description: A small pop-up: one section, no layout or tabs.
